description: This file defines the ResourceIdentifier class used in the SuiteCRM JSON API implementation. It manages resource identification with properties like id, type, and meta, and implements interfaces for JSON API response formatting and resource identification.

classes.name: ResourceIdentifier
classes.description: Represents a JSON API resource identifier with properties for id, type, and meta, capable of generating JSON API response data.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Sets the id property and returns a clone of the object.

methods.name: withType
methods.description: Sets the type property and returns a clone of the object.

methods.name: withMeta
methods.description: Sets the meta data and returns a clone of the object.

methods.name: setLogger
methods.description: Assigns a logger instance to the object.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Generates an array representing the resource identifier in JSON API format.

search-terms: PHP class for JSON API resource identification
